headline: Team Dynamics, from entry to detail
overview: Build org charts with team members, roles, and profiles to visualize and understand the dynamics within your team.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Team Dynamics — Landing State
steps.description: The landing page showing the org chart builder with options to add team members and define roles.
steps.screenshotAlt: Team Dynamics landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Build interactive org charts with team members and roles
Create detailed profiles for each team member
Visualize team structure and reporting relationships
Understand team composition and dynamics at a glance
tips: Add personality or working-style notes to member profiles to help the team understand each other better.
Update the org chart whenever team structure changes to keep your view accurate.
